purpose: Iso-reliability benchmarking of maintenance policies for capacity-constrained fleets
applicability_criterion: Spearman monotonicity x expected sign >= 0.8 for TBM/EAT/ORA and ORA-TBM CI at q50 below zero; diagnostic, not pre-registered; all settings reported
assumptions: cost, restoration, heterogeneity, misspecification and sensor parameters are assumptions; only the weather process is estimated from data
